items.headline: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet
items.summary: OpenAI announced it will stop letting frontier models learn directly from the live web, moving to cached and simulated internet content instead, citing security risks from adversarial or poisoned live data.

items.headline: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked
items.summary: Anthropic's public S-1 filing detailed how the company locks in large enterprise accounts, as part of its first full financial disclosure ahead of a planned public listing under the ticker ANT.

items.headline: Anthropic expected to receive high 'junk' rating from credit agencies following IPO
items.summary: A Financial Times report says credit agencies now expect Anthropic to receive a high-yield 'junk' rating after going public, reversing earlier expectations of an investment-grade rating and raising questions about the AI leader's debt profile.

items.headline: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
items.summary: The privacy-focused AI assistant Ollie will shut down on November 6 after its CEO cited the difficulty of differentiating the product and raising capital amid intense competition in the consumer AI assistant market.

items.headline: DoorDash says it's only received 'several hundred' orders from AI agents
items.summary: On its Q3 earnings call, DoorDash disclosed it has received only a few hundred orders placed by third-party AI shopping agents so far, suggesting agentic commerce adoption remains modest despite industry hype.

items.headline: Salesforce's M&A spree continues with a reported $375M deal for defense tech startup Rune
items.summary: Salesforce is reportedly acquiring Rune Technologies, a startup that builds AI software helping the U.S. military predict supply needs and manage logistics, for $375 million in cash and stock.

items.headline: Meta launches plan for $95 billion stock offering to fund AI expansion
items.summary: Meta unveiled a plan to raise $95 billion through a stock offering to help finance its aggressive build-out of AI infrastructure and data centers as capital spending across the industry accelerates.

items.headline: The AI investing story had a rough week as big tech shares slide on spending concerns
items.summary: AI-linked stocks including Nvidia, Intel, Broadcom and Qualcomm fell sharply after Amazon and Intel's earnings stoked investor worries that massive AI infrastructure spending isn't yet paying off, with Intel posting its worst day since the 1970s.

items.headline: Indian AI infrastructure firm seeks $3 billion in debt to buy Nvidia's next-gen chips
items.summary: An Indian AI infrastructure company is reportedly seeking to raise $3 billion in debt financing to purchase Nvidia's upcoming Rubin-generation GPUs, underscoring continued global demand for cutting-edge AI compute despite market jitters.

items.headline: White House makes Section 232 determination regarding foreign-made robots
items.summary: A White House investigation concluded that imports of foreign-made robots, including humanoids, pose a threat to U.S. national security and economic competitiveness, signaling possible future tariffs or trade restrictions on robotics imports.

items.headline: North American robot orders rose 24.8% in Q3 2026
items.summary: Trade group A3 reported that North American robot orders jumped nearly 25% in the third quarter of 2026, with demand from automotive component manufacturers nearly doubling, signaling renewed industrial automation investment.

items.headline: AGIBOT unveils G2 Max humanoid robot and 'Worken' productivity metric at Innovation Day
items.summary: Chinese robotics firm AGIBOT introduced its G2 Max humanoid and a new hardware platform at its Innovation Day, alongside a proposed productivity-measurement standard called Worken, as the company says its 20,000th robot has rolled off the production line.

items.headline: Bedrock Robotics secures $600 million for autonomous heavy equipment
items.summary: Bedrock Robotics raised $600 million to expand its autonomous retrofit technology for heavy construction and earthmoving equipment, one of the largest recent funding rounds in industrial robotics.
